value.name: Charlene rejects Micky
value.description: Charlene tells Micky he cannot treat them that way and suggests he belongs with the people he is sounding like.
evidence: CHARLENE You can't do that to us.
MICKY You sound like them now.
CHARLENE Maybe you're just like them and that's where you belong.

value.name: Charlene leaves the gym
value.description: Charlene turns and walks out of the gym, with O'Keefe following her out and looking back sadly at Micky.
evidence: She looks at him, turns and walks out of the gym, followed by O'Keefe, who looks sadly back at Micky.

value.name: Alice frames the breakup as fate
value.description: Alice comforts Micky by saying that everything happens for a reason and this may be for the best.
evidence: ALICE Everything happens for a reason, this could be for the best, honey.

value.name: Dicky gets geared up for sparring
value.description: Micky watches Dicky being fitted with boxing gear by Art Ramalho before the brothers square off.
evidence: Micky watches Dicky get geared up with gloves, headgear, mouth guard by Art Ramalho.
This rankles Micky as he and Dicky square off.

value.name: Dicky boasts about jail training
value.description: Dicky announces that he trained in jail, signaling he is ready to spar.
evidence: DICKY I was trainin' in jail, so I'm ready.

value.name: Brothers spar aggressively
value.description: Dicky and Micky spar hard, quickly falling back into their combative brotherly dynamic as others watch.
evidence: The two brothers spar, falling right back into it as Alice, George, others watch.

value.name: Dicky lands a head combination
value.description: Dicky moves around the ring and snaps Micky's head with a combination.
evidence: Dicky moving around the ring... He snaps Micky's head with a combination.

value.name: Micky answers with body shots
value.description: Micky retaliates by hammering Dicky with body shots.
evidence: Micky starts banging him with body shots...Bam! Bam! Bam!...

value.name: Dicky evades and jabs
value.description: Dicky tries to make Micky miss, then pushes him away, ducks, and jabs.
evidence: Dicky tries to make Micky miss.
Micky grabs him tying him up.. .Dicky pushes Micky away, ducks, jabs.. .

value.name: Micky traps Dicky's arm
value.description: Micky ties Dicky up and traps his left arm under his elbow, turning him in the ring.
evidence: Micky grabs him tying him up.. .
Micky traps Dicky's left under his elbow/arm, pulling it. . .Turning Dicky so his back
